learningObjectives: Implement structured logging for Python applications.
Distinguish logs, metrics, and traces in application monitoring.
Design an observability workflow for diagnosing application issues.

activities.title: Observability Map
activities.instruction: Connect each observability signal to its purpose.

content.concept: Logs, metrics, and traces provide complementary views of application behavior.

activities.title: Log Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify the important parts of a structured log.

content.concept: Useful logs include information such as timestamps, severity, context, and meaningful event details.

activities.title: Signal Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each problem with the most useful signal.

content.concept: Different operational questions are better answered by logs, metrics, or traces depending on the problem.

activities.title: Monitoring Workflow
activities.instruction: Build a workflow for detecting and diagnosing failures.

content.concept: Monitoring workflows combine detection, investigation, diagnosis, and corrective action.
